name: Easy "Boston Cream" Sweet Rolls with Vanilla Pudding & Chocolate Glaze

instructions.primary_message: When the oven is preheated, melt butter in a microwave or small saucepan.

Separate rolls, brush all sides with butter (including top and bottom), then transfer to a baking sheet pan. Place rolls in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until toasted, 5-7 minutes. Remove from oven, transfer to a cooling rack, and set aside.
Meanwhile, place pudding mix in a medium bowl. Add milk, vanilla, and salt, then whisk until thoroughly combined and starting to thicken, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (96 g) box instant pudding mix, vanilla-flavor
1 ½ cups whole milk
½ tsp vanilla extract
1 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Add thawed whipped topping to the bowl and gently fold to combine the custard. Place in the fridge until set, about 10 minutes.

While the custard is setting, use a sharp knife to cut a slit in one side of the toasted rolls. Using your fingers, create an opening in each roll to hold the custard. (Squish the bread against the sides to create a cavity.)

Once the custard is set, transfer to a piping bag. (Alternatively, you can use a large resealable plastic bag and cut one of the corners, making a DIY piping bag!) Working one at a time, insert the tip of the piping bag into the opening in a roll and squeeze to fill with custard (about 2 tbsp per roll). (Reserve any unused custard for another use.)

Place chocolate chips in a small microwave safe bowl and heat in 20-second increments, stirring after each, until chocolate is melted and smooth, about 2 minutes. Remove from the microwave, add butter, and stir until glaze is smooth and combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup dark chocolate chips
3 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Working one at a time, dip the top of each filled roll in the glaze, then place in the fridge until set, about 15 minutes.
Arrange rolls on a serving platter, share, and enjoy!
